from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.StarWithCoordinator(worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_COORD_WORKER_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_COORD_WORKER_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_COORD_WORKER_PROMPT_C, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_COORD_WORKER_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_COORD_WORKER_PROMPT_B], coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_COORDINATOR_PROMPT, n_rounds=3)
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_REPAIR_PROMPT_1, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_REPAIR_PROMPT_2])
        final = await seq(f"Problem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft answer:\n{draft['response']}")
        return final["response"] if final.get("response") else "```text\ncannot form target\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
